item_name: Rothco U.S. Coast Guard Deluxe Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Rothco’s U.S. Coast Guard Deluxe Low Profile Insignia Cap features a 100% brushed cotton twill, raised 3-D embroidered Coast Guard insignia on the front panel, and “Coast Guard” embroidery on the left brim.
description: Rothco’s U.S. Coast Guard Deluxe Low Profile Insignia Cap features a 100% brushed cotton twill, raised 3-D embroidered Coast Guard insignia on the front panel, and “Coast Guard” embroidery on the left brim. The internal sweatband offers superior comfort and the 2 reinforced vent holes provide additional breathability. The military hat has an adjustable hook & loop closure to create an ideal fit.
